summary: NutriVane end-to-end testing complete. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass covering auth (register/login/me/duplicate/wrong-pw), demo login, profile update with target computation, foods list/search, dashboard (totals/targets/7-day week), food logs CRUD, and AI scan endpoint (auth required + Gemini contract). Frontend (Playwright, mobile viewport 390x844): demo login lands on /home with calorie ring, macro bars, BMI card; tab bar navigation (home/history/scan/profile) works; language toggle ID<->EN updates strings; register + parental consent + onboarding form (age/height/weight + gender/goal/activity buttons) saves and routes to /home; logout returns to auth screen. No critical bugs found.

issues: SVG denominator text uses size*0.09 font-size which can render very small on 390px viewport; consider larger secondary text for readability.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py loads env at import time with load_dotenv before importing bcrypt/jwt - fine, but consider consolidating.
compute_targets is called on every /auth/me and /dashboard - cheap but could be cached in user doc after profile update.
scan_food/scan_spice duplicate ~30 lines of image + Gemini setup - extract a shared helper.
No rate limiting or brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (spec's auth playbook typically requires lockout after 5 fails). Not requested in feature list, so informational only.
seed_demo only creates 5 offsets but only 3 sample_days templates (mod 3) - functional but comment could clarify.
delete_food_log returns {ok:true} even when nothing matched; consider 404 for missing id owned by user.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend startup auto-seeds foods + demo user with 5 days of logs. Test suite creates ephemeral users pw_<ts>@nutrivane.app and TEST_ food log items (log deleted by test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses Bearer JWT (localStorage nv_token), NOT cookies. Demo login button on Auth screen works instantly. Onboarding gender/goal/activity are buttons with data-testids gender-<male|female>, goal-<maintain|gain|lose|healthier>, activity-<low|light|moderate|high>. Scan requires real food image for meaningful Gemini output; tiny 1x1 PNG may return 200 with empty items or 502 - both accepted by test. Warning banner only appears if sodium>2000mg or sugar>25g on the day; demo seed data doesn't trip it.
